# siheom

> Data-first frontend test interpreter. Tests are data (given / action / assert / effect steps); an interpreter runs them in a real browser.

## Docs

- Korean (default): /intro
- English: /en/intro
- Glossary: CONTEXT.md in repo root
- Timers: /concepts/effects · /en/concepts/effects
- Countdown example: /examples/countdown · /en/examples/countdown
- shadcn/ui examples (18 scenarios — Tabs, Dropdown/Context Menu, Command palette, Select/Combobox, Data Table, Calendar, Sheet, Alert, upload+Progress, Input OTP, Sidebar+Breadcrumb, drag-and-drop, Chart, streaming chat): /examples · /en/examples
- Headless UI guide: /guides/headless-components · /en/guides/headless-components
- Hangul IME (@siheom/ime): /guides/ime · /en/guides/ime

## Primary API (@siheom/react)

```ts
import {
  actions,
  assertions,
  effect,
  given,
  query,
  runSiheom,
  withFakeTimers,
} from "@siheom/react";
```

Do not use `await` in the test body — `return runSiheom(...)`.

### Fake timers

```ts
return runSiheom(
  withFakeTimers(
    given.render(<TimerApp />),
    actions.click(query.button("Start")),
    effect.elapsed(1_000),
    assertions.textContent(query.timer("Time remaining"), "24:59"),
  ),
);
```

- `withFakeTimers(...steps)` — scoped fake timers (restore after)
- `effect.elapsed(ms)` / `effect.runAllTimers()` — advance time
- Assert with normal assertions + `query.timer` — no timer-specific assert API
- When using `overrideSiheom`, pass `effects: reactEffects` and `fakeTimerScope: reactFakeTimerScope` on the base

## Runtime

- Recommended: vitest browser mode (Playwright provider), real Chromium
- Not recommended: jsdom, happy-dom (except package-unit tests)

## Factory (@siheom/core)

- `extendSiheom` — add new registry keys (actions, assertions, givens, effects, messages)
- `overrideSiheom` — replace existing registry keys; preserves `fakeTimerScope` from base
- Runtime contract: framework supplies `given.render`, not a separate Runtime type

## Locators

- `query.*` uses ARIA role + accessible name (same information as screen readers)
- `query.timer("…")` for `role="timer"`
- `query.label("…")` resolves the **labeled control**, not the `<label>` element
- Headless Select: role may be `combobox` → use `query.combobox("…")` (Ark UI), not always `query.label`
- No CSS selectors, test ids, or xpath

## Headless UI (Radix, React Aria, Ariakit, Ark UI)

Full guide: /guides/headless-components · /en/guides/headless-components

- Read `[A11y Snapshot]` before changing queries — match **role + accessible name**
- No keyboard workarounds (`{ArrowDown}{Enter}`) or test hacks (`noValidate`, `disableEnforceFocus`)
- Select open query by library:
  - React Aria, Radix, Ariakit → `query.label("…")` (label wired to trigger)
  - Ark UI → `query.combobox("…")` (trigger role is combobox)
- Headless Select + forms: hidden input / `HiddenSelect` / React Aria `name` — not native FormData alone
- Ariakit: native `<label htmlFor>`, not `SelectLabel`; checkbox `render={<button />}` on React 19
- MUI: not recommended (floating labels, dialog+menu aria-hidden, unstable options in browser tests)
- Reference specs: `apps/react-example/test/stories/headless/`

## Failure reports

- Structured logs + original error + accessibility snapshot
- Section headers customizable via message map (`logs`, `originalErrorMessage`, `a11ySnapshot`)

## E2E

- Multi-page E2E is not supported yet; Playwright-based E2E may come later
- Component/integration tests in real browser are the current focus

## Hangul IME (@siheom/ime)

Full guide: /guides/ime · /en/guides/ime

- `createImeActions({ profile })` → `overrideSiheom({ actions })` replaces `fill`/`type`
- Default profile: `linux-chrome-ibus-hangul`; also `macos-safari`, `macos-chrome-apple`, `windows-chrome-ms`, …
- user-event alone does not fire real composition — use `@siheom/ime` for Hangul bugs
- Common app fixes: no DOM focus on options mid-composition; sync controlled value; swallow Enter after `compositionend`; clamp `maxLength` on input; defer combobox keys + strip Chrome `김金`
- Reference: `apps/react-example/test/stories/ime-bugs/`
